purpose: E13 GPT full-context vs RAG architecture validation (DEV = Role B)
sampling_algorithm: Pool = DEV cases not in the historical 150-case seed-42 sample and not in any data/golden case (case-level exclusion; document-level exclusion infeasible). Per class: sort doc ids, shuffle with random.Random(1400), take <= 2 cases/doc until 50. Sorted by (class, doc, hyp). Performance-agnostic; no hard-case enrichment.
